hypothesis: Under supplied closed-world source completeness and D4/minimum-cardinality priors, the unique minimum finite-orbit generator set that rejects all absent inferred-line-compatible N12 boards preserves all176source positives and transfers to the exact N13 queen-plus-camel attack graph.
antecedent: H3w permutation search approaches the filtered support ceiling, but308false target attack pairs persist. This adaptive follow-up uses known complete source coverage to distinguish redundant global absences from the smallest local rule set.

source.completeness: Explicitly supplied: this bank contains every valid source board. Only under this closed-world assumption may absent line-compatible boards be treated as negative.

inference.offsets: Canonical half-plane dr=0,dc>0 or dr>0,dc in[-11,11]. Count occupied cell pairs in all176positive source boards.
inference.lines: Unchanged primitive-normal selector: a,b in[-2,2],gcd(abs(a),abs(b))=1, canonical positive first nonzero entry; retain if at least3member offsets have zero source count and no member offset has positive count. Require inferred row andcolumn lines to justify complete row-wise q12 enumeration.
inference.universe: Enumerate every q12placement satisfying every inferred line. With inferred row exclusion, q12implies one object perrow. Positive iff exactly present in complete source bank; every absent board isnegative.
inference.candidates: All D4orbits fully contained in the off-line source-zero offsets, under sign flips and coordinate exchange. Canonical generator is sorted absolute displacement pair. No geometry or target labels enter selection.
inference.objective: Exhaustively enumerate every subset of candidate orbits. A selected orbit rejects a board iff any occupied pair has a displacement in that orbit. Minimize number of selected orbitgenerators while rejecting every source negative and preserving all176positives. Preserve ALLminima; no tie selection.
inference.certificate: Save full universe, positive flags, all orbit incidences, every subset cardinality/coverage and first uncovered negative witness for each non-cover. Independently re-enumerate via attack-bitmask propagation, recompute pairwise incidence literally, and check every subset/minimum/witness.

primary.metric: Unique cardinality-minimum source cover and exact N13 graph extension
primary.support: Exactly one source minimum; its unchanged finite offsets plus inferred infinite lines give zero false and zero missed N13 attack pairs.
primary.falsify: No finite cover, more than one minimum, or unique minimum with any false/missed target pair. Multiple minima are all diagnosed with best/worst errors; never select a tie using target geometry.
primary.inconclusive: Timeout, incomplete exhaustive certificate, or failed source validation. Retain partial evidence; no hidden subset truncation, budget extension or scientific retuning.

target_diagnostic: Only after source-result hash is sealed: extend the selected finite offsets unchanged and inferred lines toN13. Compare all target unordered cell pairs with privileged queen plus camel(1,3)/(3,1) attacks. All target comparisons are diagnostics after source selection.
model: For every minimum use J=float32(F),h=float32zeros169,F=int32symmetric169square,unit=float64(1),q=int64(13). No fit or coefficient tuning.

identity_mapping.canonical_arrays: Compare dtype,shape and C-order bytes for J,h,F,unit,q. Also record whole NPZ hash, but ZIP-container metadata does not alter scientific identity.

settings.initialization: uniform unused columns in nongiven rows
settings.proposal: symmetric column transposition in two nongiven rows
settings.certificate: exact integer occupied F-edge count zero including given-given edges

identity_mapping.reuse: If arrays,backend,calibration,input and seedsettings are identical, map all three audited H3w oracle outcomes. Label as inherited identity-derived evidence, with zero new search runs and no independent confirmation. If nonidentical, report structural results before any new GPUsearch budget.

budget.policy: SIGALRM60seconds bounds source selection plus independent certificate. No subset-count truncation. Targetdiagnostics occur afterward under a separate stated runtime, without altering source choices.

limits: Closed-world completeness is supplied and substantially stronger than positive examples alone.
D4 symmetry, translation-invariant finite offsets, inferred-line extrapolation and minimum-cardinality are explicit inductive priors.
One complete source universe; source uniqueness is only within this declared candidate class and size.
Success would be a symbolic derivative with added priors, not paper reproduction or general positive-only identifiability.
H3w outcome mapping reuses previously observed target results and is not an independent search experiment.
